_doc: Geo facts injected as fixtures for the KG scenario matrix. Each context holds the RAW attributes the live services return at a point (FEMA NFHL, FEMA/JP advisory ABFE, JP calificación, CRIM parcel, NOAA CZMA, JP historic zones / protected areas); the harness parses them with the same parsers the live layer service uses (locations/layers.ts). Attribute shapes mirror locations/fixtures/arcgisLayers.json (recorded 2026-09-30). No network. Live health of the services is checked separately by `npm run geo:health`.

urban_zone_x.label: Urban town center, FEMA zone X
urban_zone_x.description: Commercial lot in an urban center: zone X (minimal hazard), outside the coastal zone, commercial zoning on urban land (SU), numbered CRIM parcel.

urban_industrial_x.label: Urban industrial district, FEMA zone X
urban_industrial_x.description: Industrial-zoned urban lot, zone X, inland.

urban_residential_x.label: Urban residential district, FEMA zone X
urban_residential_x.description: Residential-zoned urban lot (R-I), zone X, inland. A non-residential use here is a change of use against the zoning.

flood_ae.label: FEMA SFHA zone AE (not floodway)
flood_ae.description: Commercial urban lot inside the 1% annual-chance floodplain (AE), outside the floodway, inland.

floodway.label: FEMA AE floodway (cauce mayor)
floodway.description: Lot in the regulatory floodway (AE, ZONE_SUBTY FLOODWAY), commercial zoning on urban land, inland.

advisory_ao_only.label: Advisory (ABFE) AO only; effective FIRM zone X
advisory_ao_only.description: Effective FEMA FIRM says zone X; only the post-María advisory map shows AO. The effective map controls Reg. 13 triggers today.

coastal_zone_x.label: Coastal zone (CZMA), FEMA zone X
coastal_zone_x.description: Inside the official coastal zone, but on high ground (zone X); tourism-commercial zoning on urban land.

coastal_ve.label: Coastal zone + FEMA VE (coastal high hazard)
coastal_ve.description: Beachfront lot: VE (SFHA, wave action) inside the coastal zone; tourism zoning on urban land.

historic_zone.label: JP historic zone, FEMA zone X
historic_zone.description: Lot inside a JP-designated historic zone (Zona Histórica), zone X, outside the coastal zone, commercial/mixed zoning.

rural_srep_agricultural.label: Rural SREP-A (specially protected agricultural land), zone X
rural_srep_agricultural.description: Rural lot on Suelo Rústico Especialmente Protegido - Agrícola with agricultural zoning (A-P), zone X, inland.

rural_src.label: Rural common land (SRC), rural general zoning, zone X
rural_src.description: Rural lot on Suelo Rústico Común with rural general zoning (R-G), zone X, inland — rustic but NOT specially protected.

road_pin_residential.label: Pin on a road (JP VIAL, CRIM TIPO V) next to a residential district
road_pin_residential.description: The user dropped the pin on the street. JP returns 'Sistema vial' and CRIM a right-of-way polygon without number: zoning/land class/parcel describe the road, never the property, and must not trigger zoning rules. FEMA X.

water_pin.label: Pin in a water body (JP AGUA, CRIM TIPO A)
water_pin.description: Pin in a lagoon/bay: JP 'Cuerpo de agua', CRIM water polygon without number. Not a lot: no zoning/land-class/conservation rules may fire. Coastal zone inside, FEMA AE.

conservation_coastal.label: Conservation district (C-R) on SREP-E land, coastal zone, FEMA AE
conservation_coastal.description: Coastal lot zoned Conservación de Recursos on Suelo Rústico Especialmente Protegido - Ecológico, in AE, inside the coastal zone (mirrors the recorded Toa Baja AE point).

layers_unknown.label: Map services unavailable (all layers unknown)
layers_unknown.description: Every layer service is down: no location fact may exist, so no location rule may fire (and nothing may claim zone X).
